pages.text: The Tinkers' tools and weapons added by this mod can all be forged at the $(bold)Tinkers' Crafting Station / Part Builder$() (each is assembled from the matching part + a handle). Click each tool to see how to obtain and play with it:$(li)$(l:tools/tool_war_scythe)War Scythe$(): high attack damage and wide reach — build up Fever to dash and unleash the ultimate slash$(li)$(l:tools/tool_flying_sword)Flying Sword$(): right-click to fire a homing flying sword; toggle pursuit mode; equip it in a foot curio slot to gain flight$(li)$(l:tools/tool_yo_yo)Yo-Yo$(): launch a spinning orb that keeps dealing damage, then flies back$(li)$(l:tools/tool_silent_glove)Silent Glove$(): automatically draws your weapon when your hand is empty; expands ring slots$(li)$(l:tools/tool_dragon_staff)Dragon Staff$(): tame / recall / release Ice and Fire dragons$(li)$(l:tools/tool_modular_staff)Modular Staff$(): melee combat plus boosted Cursed Technique damage$(li)$(l:tools/tool_durandal_sword)Durandal Sword$(): the legendary unbreakable sword$(br2)$(bold)Cursed Tools$() (vanilla weapon logic, a separate category): the $(l:cursed_tools/tool_tian_ni_huo)Inverted Spear of Heaven$(), $(l:cursed_tools/cursed_tool_gourd_jail)Prison Realm$() and more can be found in the $(l:cursed_tools)Cursed Tools$() category.$(br2)Parts: the $(bold)Dragon Soul Core / Spell Core$() — see the $(l:basics/core)Cursed Energy Core$() chapter.
